name: Siloe Garden Eco Sanctuary
comment: Siloe Garden operates cloud-forest ecotourism and a native plant nursery in La Cangreja, El Guarco, Cartago, Costa Rica (1,600 m.a.s.l.), offering guided interpretive trails, student workshops, a 120 m² nursery, and picnic areas while protecting about 1 hectare of cloud forest. Taxonomy CT-AF-009 Bioeconomy & NbS; deck Drive id 1jTvgjZG0U6DCMySUZRcUtlLcwcM-Uuyu.

name: Agrismart
comment: Agrismart is a Salvadoran startup developing a machine-learning smart crop monitoring system (from about $300 per system) that combines environmental data in one dashboard to help greenhouses, nurseries, and commercial farmers save water and improve productivity. Taxonomy CT-IC-005 Precision Ag & Smart Grid; deck Drive id 1g9Gzs9liiq6gRuUwe7eKHS-62Nkv3FCe.

name: NUTRICHAR
comment: NUTRICHAR produces coconut-shell nano-biochar and offers Nutrichar Premium (PaaS) with an IoT field monitoring station, targeting specialty coffee and other high-value crop producers in El Salvador to retain soil moisture and support regenerative agriculture. Taxonomy CT-AF-010 Organic & Regenerative Ag; deck Drive id 1vAFw9DyfTt7sylKr1vC-zNnncxtHp06s.

name: SMARTDRIVE
comment: SMARTDRIVE provides a rent-to-own platform supplying Kaiyi electric vehicles (about 400 km range) to ride-hail drivers on platforms such as Uber and InDrive for a fixed weekly rate (deck cites $210/week), aiming to cut fuel costs versus combustion vehicles. Taxonomy CT-TR-001 Electric Vehicles; deck Drive id 1sVFS6YrGqLNz4QGo3Jk7lODqgeWHP9CW.

name: Q-Mind
comment: Q-Mind offers a virtual laboratory that uses multi-material physical optimization and AI to optimize tandem and quantum-dot solar cell designs for manufacturers and R&D labs, with a deck-cited subscription of about $5,000 per year. Taxonomy CT-EN-001 Solar PV; deck Drive id 1oE2ntkNZOTlCMEHmNjCDtwFPI9ZDLZCR.

name: Crysalia Studio
comment: Crysalia Studio designs furniture and decor pieces from aesthetically rejected wood for interior designers, specialized stores, and real-estate developers in Guatemala, valorising wood that would otherwise be waste. Taxonomy CT-IN-003 Circular Economy & Clean Mfg; deck Drive id 150BxTeTHV8BnZNTliBr4BN_Cy9KwdAAf.

name: Águilas Verdes
comment: Águilas Verdes farm produces chemical-free meat from animals raised with high welfare and environmentally responsible practices; the deck states production sequesters over 4 tons of CO2 per head annually and targets restaurants, butcher shops, and consumers in Costa Rica. Taxonomy CT-AF-004 Silvopastoral Systems; deck Drive id 1n2S-kCWo3_OSK3QAQRSxVAcn5LZjJH5Z.

name: Piña and Kakaw
comment: Piña and Kakaw sells sustainable pineapple-fiber blended yarn and fabric (pineapple plus cotton) to fashion brands and textile manufacturers, upcycling agricultural waste into natural fibers instead of fossil-based textiles. Taxonomy CT-EX-038 Sustainable Textiles (Wood/Fibre); deck Drive id 1TVyQ5vpF1vDlfmosXH6PTwtFgIu2PZNq.
